text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Science Technology Laboratory AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × DSTL MOD Defence Science Technology Laboratory AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK Defence Science and Technology Laboratory — applied research, technology readiness levels, autonomous systems evaluation, CBRN detection, cyber defence research, and defence AI assurance. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Research Portfolio Applied Research Portfolio AI TRL 1-6 research programme management across Dstl's S&T portfolio. Investment prioritisation across defence lines of development. Programme dependency mapping and cross-domain synergy detection. Portfolio risk assessment with technology maturity scoring. Funding allocation optimisation across competing MOD priorities. Programme milestone tracking with automated amber/red flagging. Research output quality metrics and impact assessment. Strategic S&T foresight modelling against emerging threats. Collaboration tracking across DASA, QinetiQ, and academia. Annual Defence S&T Plan alignment and reporting. Autonomous Systems Autonomous Systems Evaluation AI UGV/USV/UAV test and evaluation at MOD ranges. AI trust calibration for autonomous decision-making. Safety assurance case construction per Def Stan 00-056. Human-machine interface testing under operational stress. Autonomous system behavioural verification and validation. Swarm autonomy evaluation at formation and task level. Adversarial robustness testing against spoofing and jamming. TRL gate compliance for capability insertion. Lethal autonomous weapons policy compliance. Mission assurance for semi-autonomous modes. CBRN CBRN Detection AI Chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear sensor fusion. Agent identification with false-positive/negative optimisation. Real-time plume modelling and dispersion prediction. Bio-aerosol classification from environmental sampling. Radiation portal monitoring with anomaly detection. Decontamination effectiveness via sensor feedback. CBRN situational awareness for C4ISR integration. Medical countermeasure recommendation engines. Forensic attribution for chemical and biological agents. NATO CBRN warning network (STANAG 2461). Cyber Cyber Defence Research AI Offensive/defensive cyber capability research. Vulnerability assessment for weapons and C4ISR platforms. Network traffic anomaly detection at defence classification. Malware reverse engineering and signature generation. Cyber range scenario generation for exercises. Supply chain cyber risk for procurement. Zero-trust architecture for classified networks. Adversarial ML attack and defence research. CEMA integration research. Export control compliance for cyber outputs. Human Performance Human Performance AI Cognitive load assessment for military decision-making. Human-machine teaming effectiveness measurement. Fatigue modelling for 24/7 sustained operations. Crew resource management for multi-platform ops. Psychological resilience under combat stress. Training effectiveness via performance analytics. Workload balancing for human-autonomy teams. Decision quality under time pressure and uncertainty. Augmented cognition for situational awareness. Ethics board compliance for monitoring systems. Materials Materials Science AI Advanced materials discovery via computational screening. Metamaterial design for radar-absorbing shielding. Stealth coatings for platform signature reduction. Lightweight armour using multi-scale modelling. High-temperature materials for propulsion. Additive manufacturing optimisation for components. Corrosion prediction for maritime assets. Ballistic protection performance prediction. Nanomaterial safety and toxicological profiling. Materials IP protection across Five Eyes. EW Elec
